entities.name: Ilse Stöbe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ilse Frieda Gertrud Stöbe was a German left-wing journalist, Soviet GRU agent and anti-Nazi resistance fighter. As a young woman, Stöbe was exposed to communist ideology through her parents. After her parents split up, she had to leave the Rathaus grammar school she was attending and trained as a typist.
